shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6 (sky/surface/basement) as ONE BIG MAP: live see-below view, choosable basements, full vanilla parity in work/haul/combat — verified cross-level combat (shot parity, one-map audio, tracers, one-map AI) and grouped sky drop-pod landings; CE support next; plus wide stairs, elevators, pod transit, opt-in threats, world integration, AUR guard, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below — every level a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP, and every compat/order reads + behaves as base game**.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection, foreign types in method bodies only. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. See-below / cross-gap is ONLY sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB, dim slider.
- All levels are real maps: SURFACE is the world-tile map; SKY + BASEMENT are pocket maps (PocketMapParent) added via Current.Game.AddMap, so they live in Find.Maps and **tick every game tick in real time** regardless of which is viewed. Viewing a level swaps Find.CurrentMap.
- Basement environments are choosable. Stairwells do NOT exchange heat. Sky mountain naturalistic. Pod handoff LATE (22t).
- **ALWAYS `def.graphicData.Graphic`.** Settings IMGUI discipline. Cross-level work: strictly-better rank, main-thread only, real migration probe.
- **Cross-map job guard doctrine v2**; FORCED-ORDER PARITY; NATIVE FLOAT MENU POLICY; SEAMLESS CONTINUATION; CAMERA LEVEL LOCK = HARD; IsPlayerHome column identity (ColumnAsHome).
- **FOREIGN-MAP ELIGIBILITY GATE**: z-levels excluded from foreign special maps (AUR submaps). Fail-open.
- Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir (Impassable) + plateaus AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop (Standable). Drops must land on plateaus.
- TEXTURE POLICY: user supplies stair art. PARITY AUDIT = ROADMAP (docs/).

## CROSS-LEVEL COMBAT (Model B, through-the-gap ranged) — Source/Combat/ — VERIFIED run #89
Spawn the projectile on the TARGET's map so flight/armour/impact/damage are 100% vanilla there; only acquisition (LoF + range) and launch are custom. Pawn shooters: JobDriver_ABCrossLevelAttack; turrets: CrossLevelTurret. AI auto-engage: CrossLevelAutoEngage. Gated by ABGuard.Combat + crossLevelCombat, fail-open.
- **Shot parity (ABShotEffects.cs)**: replays the full cast pipeline (soundCast+tail, ShotFlash muzzle fleck, pawn notifies via cached open-delegates, ShotsFired, changeable/charged unload, fuel, CompUniqueWeapon traits, per-burst BattleLogEntry_RangedFire + Shooting XP). Self-test 14/14.
- **One-map audio (ABCombatSoundContext.cs)**: prefix on SoundDefHelper.CorrectContextNow treats the paired sky/surface level as same audio context; ONE-SHOTS ONLY; both directions. VERIFIED.
- **Cross-level tracers (ABCrossLevelTracers.cs)**: every direct cross-level shot draws a bolt spanning both levels; bullet-paced, wall-clock timed. VERIFIED.
- **One-map AI (CrossLevelAutoEngage.cs)**: cadence 250->60t; nearest-target-across-both-levels acquisition (NearestSameMapEnemyDistSq vs cross-level target; TryEngageAcross maxDistSq). VERIFIED.

## SKY DROP-POD LANDING (ABSkyDropCells.cs + ThreatDivert redirect exemption) — 2026-07-23
FIX for "pod raids scatter across the lower level / won't land on the mountains". TWO root causes:
1. **Cell finding (ABSkyDropCells.cs, self-test 7/7)**: the sky is mostly impassable open air, so vanilla's FindRaidDropCenterDistant can pick a bad center (last resort AllCells.RandomElement) and TryFindDropSpotNear (radius 16, no snap) fails -> DropPodUtility.DropThingGroupsNear falls back to CellFinderLoose.RandomCellWith(walkable) = random cell anywhere -> scatter. Sky-only patches: FindRaidDropCenterDistant postfix snaps a bad center onto the nearest plateau; TryFindDropSpotNear prefix (9-arg overload via TargetMethod+MakeByRefType) runs a plateau-aware clustered search (snap to nearest plateau anchor, then CellFinder.TryFindRandomCellNear with growing radius + plateau+reachable validator) so the scatter fallback never fires. Covers BOTH the public DropThingGroupsNear path AND PawnsArrivalModeWorker_SpecificLocationDrop's private "drop in a radius" copy (it calls the same public TryFindDropSpotNear long overload).
2. **THE actual user-reported bug - pocket redirect (ThreatDivert.Patch_Incident_PocketRedirect)**: that patch bounces ANY incident targeting a pocket level to the surface (`parms.target = ground`) but LEAVES `parms.spawnCenter` pointing at the sky plateau. So a pod-drop raid aimed at the sky ran on the SURFACE at plateau coords (under the mountain) -> TryFindDropSpotNear fails there -> random-walkable scatter across the lower level. FIX: exempt sky pod-drops from the redirect - `ThreatDivert.IsSkyPodDrop(parms, sky)` returns true when spawnCenter is a valid non-open-air plateau cell OR raidArrivalMode.Worker is any drop worker (EdgeDrop/CenterDrop/RandomDrop/EdgeDropGroups/SpecificLocationDrop); when true and level>=1 the redirect is skipped and the drop lands on the sky where the cell-finding fix groups it on the plateaus. Basement drops + all non-drop incidents still redirect. Self-test extended (9 checks) with two deterministic exemption assertions.

## COMBAT EXTENDED SUPPORT — NEXT (Phase 2)
CE (decompiled 1.6): Verb_LaunchProjectileCE : Verb (NOT Verb_LaunchProjectile), ProjectileCE : ThingWithComps (NOT Projectile). GetRangedVerb returns null for CE weapons -> cross-level ranged currently INERT with CE (no crash; walk stairs). Plan: reuse geometry/LoF, spawn ProjectileCE on target map via CE Launch(launcher,origin,shotAngle,shotRotation,shotHeight,shotSpeed,equipment,distance) - shotHeight = elevation lever for plunging fire. Decided: SIMPLER-CUT accuracy (our aim roll for hit/miss, CE ballistics+armour+suppression downstream); PARITY ammo (consume magazine via CompAmmoUser). Packaging: isolated compat assembly hard-ref CombatExtended.dll, LoadFolders `<li IfModActive="CETeam.CombatExtended">`, CE types in method bodies / object-typed signatures only. Tracers + one-map audio + one-map AI are verb-agnostic and apply to CE shots once routed through a Fire-equivalent.

## SEE-BELOW view (BelowSelection / LevelRenderer / BelowThingOverlays)
Plumb one-way mirror (sky level 1 draws surface below; parallax removed, altitude-drop only). Filter: a lower thing draws only when the sky cell above it is open air + unroofed + unfogged + in view. Fail-open.

## BASEMENT ENVIRONMENTS — 2026-07-23
Unified basementType setting. Types: SolidRock (default), Caverns (Biomes! Caverns), Foreign biome carve (4 Alpha Biomes), UrbanRuins (AUR buried facility). REVEAL ON LOAD (basementRevealed, default ON).

## POD TRANSIT (PodTransit.cs)
Descending skyfallers bound for the surface pass through the sky airspace when the sky cell above is an open gap (exposed to AA), handed off late (22t). Sky-spawned pods over open air take the downward leg only. Setting podTransit.

## HAULING / AUR COMPAT
Hauling (Scope B): ABInventoryHaulBridge -> CrossLevelHaulJob.Build -> JobDriver_ABBulkHaulAcrossLevels + WorkGiver (PUAH+HD verified). AUR (XMB.AncientUrbanrUins.MO): reflection, fail-open; z-levels excluded from AUR submaps by default; basement facility stamp with portals stripped.

## VERIFIED BASELINE (runs #62/#86; combat parity #88 14/14; combat feel #89; sky drop-grouping #91 7/7)
Priority work; select in place; right-click orders; merged colonist bar; stairs/elevators; work/haul/supply/needs/medical/prisoners; see-below renderer; through-gap combat (parity+audio+tracers+one-map AI VERIFIED); pod transit + AA; sky drop landings; caravans; opt-in threats; world integration; wealth; rituals; social; camera lock; naturalistic peaks; BC caverns; MO formations; BM variant; modder API. PUAH/HD bulk + Allow Tool urgent good.

## SETTINGS — SEVEN tabs: Generation / View and camera / Work and logistics / Job scanning / Combat and threats / Compat / Advanced.

## Dev-tools — ensure sky+basement; self-test suite (cross-gap combat, auto-engage, pod transit, sky drop-grouping, etc.); below-view diagnostic.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE risers. Biomes! Caverns (soft). Alpha Biomes (soft). BM + MO (verified). Odyssey landmarks + VLE (soft). Misc. Robots + Robots++ (verified). Hauler's Dream + PUAH (verified). Allow Tool. Ancient urban ruins. **Combat Extended: cross-level ranged INERT (Phase 2 next); parity/audio/tracer/one-map-AI/drop layer is vanilla-only for now.** Achtung!/Reverse/Giddy-up/Vehicle Framework/Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF (soft). INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded.

## Status
2026-07-23: **Sky pod-raid landing FIXED (round 2)** - the real cause of "pods scatter across the lower level / won't land on the mountains" was the pocket-redirect (Patch_Incident_PocketRedirect) bouncing a sky-aimed drop raid to the surface while keeping the sky spawnCenter, so it dropped at under-mountain coords and hit vanilla's random-walkable scatter. Fix: ThreatDivert.IsSkyPodDrop exempts sky pod-drops from the redirect, so they land on the sky where ABSkyDropCells groups them on the plateaus. Build green (0/0). Self-test extended to 9 checks (2 deterministic exemption asserts). PENDING: user to re-test their exact scenario (dev-drop a pod raid in a radius on a sky plateau -> should land grouped on the mountains). THEN Phase 2 (Combat Extended). Outstanding chores: translation audit, palette pin watch, mech escort, settings preview, VCHE, soak, publishing prep.
